outcome: placental epigenetic gestational age (GA) at birth
cohort: The study leveraged 103 mother-offspring pairs from the Early Autism Risk Longitudinal Investigation cohort.
finding: Higher prenatal O3 and PM10 exposures, especially during mid- to late-pregnancy (weeks 21-31 and 21-29 respectively), were associated with decelerated placental epigenetic gestational age at birth, indicating lower biological maturity.
